intents.label: login_account_access
intents.description: Trouble logging in, password reset, 2FA, email verification, or locked account.
example_phrases: I forgot my password and email is not receiving reset link
Locked out of my account

intents.label: subscription_billing
intents.description: Charges, unexpected billing, payment failed, receipt, currency, or price changes.
example_phrases: Why was I charged twice this month?
My card was debited but account shows Free

intents.label: plan_discount_management
intents.description: Family plan invites, Duo plan, Student verification (SheerID), upgrading or downgrading plans.
example_phrases: How do I add my partner to Duo?
My student discount verification failed on SheerID

intents.label: playback_technical_issue
intents.description: Songs pausing, crashing, offline downloads failing, local files, audio skipping, or error codes.
example_phrases: App keeps crashing on startup on Android 14
Songs stop playing after 10 seconds

intents.label: device_connectivity
intents.description: Bluetooth, Spotify Connect, Alexa, smart speaker, CarPlay, PlayStation, or TV app issues.
example_phrases: Spotify Connect cannot discover my Sonos speakers
CarPlay disconnects randomly

intents.label: content_playlist_availability
intents.description: Missing songs, greyed out tracks, lyrics not showing, explicit content toggle, or playlist loss.
example_phrases: Why is this album greyed out in my country?
My playlist disappeared overnight

intents.label: cancellation_refund
intents.description: Cancelling Premium subscription, switching to Free, refund requests.
example_phrases: I want to cancel my premium and get a refund
Please cancel my auto-renew

intents.label: security_compromised_account
intents.description: Unauthorized changes, stranger playing music on account, email changed without permission, hacked.
example_phrases: Someone in another country is using my account and changed my email
My account got hacked

intents.label: how_to_feature_request
intents.description: Inquiries about how features work, UI navigation, feature suggestions, or feedback.
example_phrases: How do I enable crossfade on desktop?
Can you add folder support for mobile playlists?

intents.label: service_outage
intents.description: Widespread outage reports, server errors (500s), service down for everyone.
example_phrases: Is the service down right now? Nothing loads for anyone
Getting error 500 across web player

intents.label: other_unclear
intents.description: Ambiguous, spam, non-English, greetings without question, or out-of-scope messages.
example_phrases: Hello?
Yo check out my music @SpotifyCares
